calls.title: LiveSport + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the implementation of GrowthBook SDK to unify mobile and web experimentation, which aims to reduce engineering overhead and costs associated with maintaining separate tests. Key elements included managing high traffic efficiently with a predictable pricing model that contrasts with impression-based billing. The adoption of feature flags is expected to accelerate app experimentation cycles by decoupling tests from app release schedules. Unified user identification and data analytics integration will provide better cross-platform tracking and evaluation of experiments. Additionally, the team highlighted the importance of transparent metric definitions to satisfy business intelligence needs, supported by dedicated implementation resources to streamline the transition to GrowthBook.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Mobile SDK, Feature Flags, Data Warehouse, AI Integration

calls.title: LiveSport + GrowthBook Commercials
calls.summary: The procurement process is progressing with a key presentation scheduled for Tuesday, followed by an internal cost analysis and leadership review leading up to April's contract expiration. Prioritizing a new AB testing solution is essential to avoid disruptions from the expiring contract, with a target signing date of January 1st. The current annual spend is €60,000 for 100 million impressions, but the unlimited usage cost from Optimizely is too high at €500,000. There’s also a significant focus on minimizing spend on mobile experimentation, currently managed through Firebase, while exploring alternatives due to rising costs. The team is evaluating Optimizely alongside Airship and Extreme Push and seeks a flexible pricing model from Growth Book that promises a potential revenue uplift from mobile experimentation.
calls.keywords: AB testing, Procurement, Experimentation, Pricing, Mobile SDK, Optimizely
